title: Prompt Injection Slides | Approaches To Protect LLM
description: LLM 101 - This slide session walk thru LLM applications, architecture and building blocks. Slides describe open source vs closed LLM and how to choose. Slides also focus on LLM steerability. Session slides also describe prompt engineering , tokenization and factors to consider while building applications using LLM. At last it describe process architectur, component architecture and how to estimate cost of LLM.
keywords: security vulnerability in LLMs (Large Language Models)
causing LLM to perform unintended actions
